limits: Uncalibrated route/model scores are explicitly labelled and never described as measured accuracy.
Observed scan discrepancy/reference MAE is a partial variation proxy, not an error bound.
Zero coverage discrepancy does not imply zero detection error. Unknown semantic/physical error is not assigned a fabricated bound.
When no numerical confidence exists, pct stays null rather than inventing accuracy; all 28 public real-answer cases carried a recorded score or historical reference.
A zero coverage-only discrepancy does not estimate missed detections; its numeric component is labelled coverage only.
A zero area from absent scale is withheld; inventory comparisons remain element counts, not square metres.
Missing physical uncertainty on a planner-supplied reader scale remains unknown; no finite physical error bound is manufactured.
